name: @ericrius1/cast
description: The cast's procedural character runtime, shared by every project: the hero rig (gait, flight, swimming, seats and holds, the arm fit with elbow continuity, finger IK, verlet hair and cloth, the face), garments, strands, a stroke planner for anything swung, keyed tracks, the whole-body solver, and the articulation of a body playing an instrument. CPU only, no renderer.
author: Eric Levin
